blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Speaker Faustino “Bojie” Dy III has assured the public that the House of Representatives’s priority remains to be education, noting that one of the purposes of the chamber’s listening program is to check the needs of communities in terms of education. During the fifth leg of the LegisHear initiative, held on Friday in Victorias City, Negros Occidental, Dy said that the House remains committed to pushing for investments in Filipino teachers, students and safer schools, as it is a key to giving children a better future. “Nakita po natin na napakahalaga po ng edukasyon sa bawat lugar, sa bawat […]...
